summary: Backend regression + new-feature testing for iteration 16 (notes field + partial-update remaining_principal fix). Created /app/backend/tests/test_iteration16_notes_regression.py with 15 pytest test cases covering login, notes round-trip on POST/PUT/add-entry endpoints, partial-update non-corruption regression, enhanced ledger user_note + interest_start_date, status->closed via PUT, and regression of accounts list/dashboard/ledger/villages/close-reopen/exports. All 15 tests pass.

minor.issue: interest_rate fallback uses `or 2` which treats 0 as missing (0 -> defaults to 2). If a user genuinely sets 0% interest, the system silently applies 2%. Recommend: `interest_rate = float(landed_entry.get('interest_rate') if landed_entry.get('interest_rate') is not None else 2)`.

action_items: (Optional/minor) Fix `or 2` fallback for interest_rate so a 0% rate is honored verbatim instead of defaulting to 2%.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/accounts.py is ~750 lines including a complex 250-line get_enhanced_ledger handler. Recommend splitting the enhanced-ledger simulation into services/financial.py (or a new services/ledger.py) for testability and reuse.
_fmt_inr helper sits in accounts.py route module — better placed in utils.py.

PUT /api/accounts/{id} reprocesses landed/received entries when only received_entries is in the payload (lines 188-198), which resets all carried_forward_interest/interest_start_date on existing landed entries. This could be a similar latent regression risk if a user adds a single received entry via PUT-update mode (not via /received endpoint). Consider always preferring the /landed and /received POST endpoints for additive changes.

create_account ignores user-supplied remaining_principal/last_interest_calc_date/accumulated_interest fields on LandedEntry (good), but the model still exposes them — could remove from Pydantic input model to reduce surface area.

Enhanced-ledger breakdown mutates `_le` (active landed list) for side-effects on carried_forward and interest_start_date — works because `pop('_le', None)` is called after, but the in-place mutation of `active` makes the simulation harder to reason about. Consider a pure-functional re-simulation.
seed_data_creation: Each test class creates TEST_-prefixed accounts and deletes them in teardown. No leftover data expected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iteration16_notes_regression.py is the canonical regression suite for the notes feature + partial-update bug. It fully covers: notes on create/get/update/add-entry endpoints, enhanced ledger user_note + interest_start_date, close-via-PUT close_history, partial PUT remaining_principal preservation, and basic regression of accounts/dashboard/ledger/villages. Image upload was not retested in this iteration — covered in test_iteration10/11_image_upload tests. Export endpoint prefix is /api/export (not /api). Earlier route-conflict suspicion (excel matching {account_id}) was a false alarm — paths are correctly namespaced.
rca of the issue: No new bugs reported. Two test-script issues encountered and self-fixed: (1) initial partial-update test used interest_rate=0 which got coerced to 2 by `or 2` fallback in financial.py, leaving 0.67 residual principal — fixed by using same date for landed and received (0 days = 0 interest). (2) Enhanced-ledger user_note assertion checked for original 'Initial loan' text, but a prior test in the same module had updated the note via full-payload PUT — fixed by asserting any non-empty user_note propagation.
